title: [RIFT] Gakuran | AUTOPARRY | ESP | NO COOLDOWN  |AND MORE OP
features:
🥋 Gakuran — Rift

A combat-focused hub built around intelligent defense, faster reactions, combat modifiers, and player utilities.

Features include:

Advanced Auto Parry — Automatically detects incoming attacks and reacts with properly timed parries.

Adaptive Parry Timing — Dynamically adjusts timing for more consistent defensive reactions.

Multi-Style Support — Designed to recognize and handle different fighting styles and attack timings.

M1 & M2 Detection — Handles different attack types with separate timing logic.

Auto Punish — Automatically capitalizes on openings after successful defensive actions.

No Parry Cooldown — Improves responsiveness between consecutive parry attempts.

No Block Cooldown — Allows faster repeated blocking.

No Dodge Cooldown — Reduces downtime between evasive actions.

Targeting Tools — Combat-focused target tracking and camera assistance.

Auto Sprint — Automatically keeps your character sprinting when appropriate.

Noclip — Toggle character collision for easier movement.

Performance Mode — Improves FPS while maintaining reasonable visual quality.

Player ESP — Makes nearby players easier to track.

Config System — Save and automatically load your preferred Rift settings.

Miscellaneous Utilities — Additional combat and quality-of-life features.
